svg.aria-label: The notebook's sampling lines, with handwritten notes. probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1): the wheel, 65 chances, one for each possible next letter, adding up to 1. next_id = torch.multinomial(probs, num_samples=1): the spin, a random point from 0 to 1, then a walk round the wheel to the slice it lands in. idx = torch.cat([idx, next_id], dim=1): the new ID goes on the end of the text, ready to go round again.
svg.text: Spinning the wheel, in the notebook's Python
From generate_text; the handwritten notes are my own reading
